description:
If we would be forced to choose one bike for life, Vedder would be it.

Mountainbikers by heart but living in the lowest country in the world…. Which means we have some distance to cover from the workshop over road and gravel before we can hit the local trails. We did it on our regular gravelbikes, but the lack of suspension and a high seat made the descents less fun than we would have liked.

So we made the Vedder.

Room for big tyres up to at least 55mm, a longer reach and longer rear, with room for a proper dropper and built for either a suspension fork or a rigid fork. Both fast and stable on gravel, as predictable and fun on the trails.

Vedder is available in titanium and steel with 3D printed yokes and dropouts. For titanium the standard finish is blasted prints, brushed tubing and a polished and anodised front in a color of your choice. Full polished finishes are available at a surcharge.

For steel we offer any RAL color powdercoat and some special colors at a surcharge.

Vedder comes standard with internal routing (nót through the headset!) and mounts for 3 bottlecages. Other mounts are optional at a surcharge.

Vedder is (of course) UDH and Transmission compatible and standard 160mm flatmount.

Bottom bracket is the excellent internal T47 at 86.5mm wide and the frame will fit a 46t wide/XPLR chainring.

Every Vedder is handmade to measure in our workshop in Wijchen, the Netherlands.
